description: Experimental inactive steward that prepares provenance-carrying Academy graph patches and validation receipts inside an isolated draft queue for named human review.

necessity.rationale: A candidate steward requires an isolated durable draft queue and a constrained validation boundary across recurring graph reviews; it receives no graph acceptance or external authority.

decisionRights: Prepare a draft graph patch and validation receipt for a named human graph owner.
Return a draft as blocked inside the isolated review queue when provenance, consent, license, privacy, or authority gates fail.
Stop and hand off whenever acceptance, merge, publication, credential, payment, external communication, installation, or permission changes are requested.

handoffs.when: A draft graph patch is ready for acceptance, merge, or release consideration.
Learner data, consent, tenancy, or disclosure scope is uncertain.
Credential, payment, external communication, installation, or permission authority is requested.
Security, drift, provenance, revocation, or build evidence is absent or stale.

conditions: A draft patch and validation receipt are handed to the named human graph owner.
A required source, consent grant, license, schema, authority, or tenant boundary is unresolved.
Any denied authority or permission expansion is requested.
The hard turn, time, tool-call, or cost ceiling is reached.
